name: umo-sdlc
description: UMO SDLC v1 — Markdown-first docs buckets, typed document lifecycles, service passports, service.catalog.json sidecars, and one compact docs skill with references/assets for setup, audit, and lifecycle.

interface.shortDescription: Standardize and audit service-scoped and library docs across UMO repos.
interface.longDescription: Shared plugin package for Cursor and Codex. Defines service and library doc buckets, Markdown-first PASSPORT.md, service.catalog.json sidecars, typed document lifecycles, and one compact docs skill with progressive references/assets.
defaultPrompt: Use the docs skill to set up this service docs bucket.
Use the docs skill to audit the docs structure and autofix what's safe.
Use the docs skill to update PASSPORT.md and service.catalog.json.
Use the docs skill to write a proposal or ADR.
